codeql_review.flow: daemon_transport.go ReadMessage -> custom generic Read buffer -> cmd/ailang/run_policy_supervise.go copyCapped src.Read/dst.Write -> statusWriter/responseRecorder HTTP Write. Alternate traces pass through LSP stdio and effects limitedWriter.
codeql_review.infeasibility_evidence: copyCapped has only two concrete calls: os.Stdout plus os.Pipe, or stderrGuard plus os.Pipe. LSP stdio fields are os.Stdin/os.Stdout; limitedWriter wraps stdout/stderr bytes.Buffer. None receives daemonWebSocketStream or the HTTP wrappers. Cache is attached only to six JSON polling handlers. HTTP sink files are unchanged versus origin/dev.
codeql_review.remediation: Replace generic daemon io.Reader/io.Writer bridge with domain sendMessage/receiveMessage transport. WebSocket frames decode directly into daemonMessage and writes encode structured JSON; protocol is not arbitrary byte streaming. Preserve frame validation/limits/deadlines/cancellation. Do not HTML-escape protocol bytes, modify unrelated HTTP sinks, dismiss alerts or suppress the rule.
